Use a diagram as the starting point for a calculation or a conversation.
Try finding a missing length, then naming familiar shapes in another language.

::: {.callout-note .example-author-notes}
### For course authors

A diagram can support different learning goals. The triangle asks for a
calculation; the circle and square ask for precise vocabulary in German.
Keep the important visual facts in the feedback instructions too, so the advice
has enough information to discuss the task.
:::
